question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**him**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes an old man walking alone in a procession.
 
• The pronoun used must correctly refer back to the **old man**, who is **male**.
 
• In the phrase **“There was no one with _____”**, the correct object pronoun referring to a male person is **“him.”**
 
• Other options like “his,” “its,” or “her” are incorrect because they either show possession or refer to the wrong gender.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1 – him**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **his** – possessive pronoun, not suitable after “with.”
 
• **its** – refers to a non-living thing or animal, not a person.
 
• **her** – feminine pronoun, incorrect because the subject is an old man.
